Elena Morales: Need final copy for tri-mode landing (Hosted / Dedicated / Private). 3 hero variants, short benchmark blurb, webinar CTA, and routing notes by EOD. @Raf @Tess
Raf Chen: Draft heroes: "Ship LLM features with predictable latency and cost"; "Production-grade inference without the ops"; "One API, multiple deployment guarantees"
Tess King: Prefer the first. For Dedicated line: "Reserved capacity, SLA-backed throughput." Bullets: autoscale, burst, isolation.
Ben Ortiz: Private microcopy: "Deploy in your VPC or on-prem for full control, KMS-ready, enterprise audit logs." Keep non-technical.
Elena Morales: Add 1-line benchmark placeholder for Hosted: p95 + cost per 1k tokens, provisional.
Raf Chen: Placeholder: "Typical chat p95 <120ms; optimized path ~ $0.02 / 1k tokens (provisional)."
Tess King: CTA matrix: Hosted -> Start free trial; Dedicated -> Request pricing; Private -> Contact sales. Secondary CTA: See benchmarks.
Ben Ortiz: Routing plan: Hosted -> trial signup; Dedicated -> sales form (SFDC: Dedicated); Private -> enterprise contact -> solutions-eng ticket. Will add webhooks and SFDC mapping.
Elena Morales: Webinar planned: "Serving at scale: latency & cost playbook". Add reg CTA + 1-page benchmark PDF on landing. Target ~3 weeks.
Raf Chen: I'll update the doc with comments and mark metrics provisional until infra confirms.
Tess King: A/B test events: landing.cta.click, landing.benchmark.view, landing.webinar.register. Adding GA4 + Segment props.
Ben Ortiz: Created JIRA: INF-9123/INF-9124/INF-9125. Routing doc link in the doc.
Elena Morales: Thanks team. Final review tomorrow AM. :rocket:
